# Read-back

A product launch evening for 200 guests runs from crew call at 17:00 through venue reset at 21:00, with doors at 18:00 and the program ending by 20:00. The production uses one stage with a single projector and two-microphone PA system. A five-person crew (one producer calling the show, one AV technician, two front-of-house staff, and caterers) must complete pre-show setup including AV line check (30 min), CEO/product-lead keynote rehearsal (20 min), registration desk and foyer setup (45 min + 15 min walkthrough), and bar/canapé station setup (60 min). Doors open only after FOH confirms the walkthrough; guests register and are seated (30 min registration + 5 min ushering). The program itself runs host welcome (5 min) → CEO keynote (20 min) with AV support → product video (2 min) → live demo (25 min) → moderated Q&A (15–25 min, variable) → host close (5 min). The reception follows with canapés (45 min), FOH desk breakdown (15 min after hall clears), and AV strike (30 min after hall clears). The hard constraint is that everything—including cleanup—must finish by 21:00, and the stage/projector can only support one activity at a time.
